title: Your First Techno Groove
intro: Everything at once, the way a record works. Kick on all four beats, clap answering on 2 and 4, hats filling every offbeat, a bassline of at least four notes in the gaps, and stabs on top. If you cleared anything along the way, put it back — then press play, hold the whole thing in your ears, and take the filter for a ride while it runs.
